body:
`/models` lists Claude Code twice over: `agents.rs::claude_aliases` adds `claude-opus`, `claude-sonnet`, `claude-haiku` and `claude-fable` on top of the exact ids the list already has (the presets in `default-models.toml`, plus the ids the models endpoint lists when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set), so Opus shows as both `Claude Code · Opus (latest)` and `Claude Code · Opus 5.5`.

- `board.rs::models` serves one entry per family: the family's live exact model (preset or discovered); the alias only when the family has no live exact one. Codex's answer is exact ids already, so its entries are unchanged.
- Family: the models endpoint's `line` for a discovered model (`opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku`, `fable`); the alias's family word inside the id for a preset (`opus` in `claude-opus-5-5`).
- The alias stays in `system()["models"]`, so a task naming `claude-opus` still starts: `board.rs::model` resolves from there, not from the pick's list.
- `board_acceptance.py` expects `claude-opus` in `/models`; the fixture follows the new rule.
title: agents: one pick entry per model family
